messages:
Jordan K.: Hi team — filing this here since there are a few moving pieces. Due date 6/10, planning to start FMLA/parental leave on 6/5 for 14 weeks. Iwant to confirm paperwork deadlines, whether I should initiate backfill hiring now, and what to do about equipment/okrs.
Priya (People Ops): Congrats Jordan! :partyparrot: Quick checklist: 1) Submit LOA in Workday at least 2 pay periods before 6/5. 2) Attach your doctors note if required for FMLA. 3) Select company topup if eligible so weeks count as paid for benefits and bonus proration.
Jordan K.: Thanks. If I submit LOA by 5/15 is that enough for payroll and benefits?
Maya (Payroll): 5/15 should be fine. Payroll cutoff for June payroll is 5/20. As long as LOA is in by 5/20 and coded correctly we can mark those pay periods as paid (company_topup = yes). If LOA is late we risk misclassification and manual corrections take 23 weeks.
Lena (Hiring Ops): On backfill: if you want a temporary contractor or a headcount backfill we can start a req now with a 3045 day lead. Hiring Ops recommends starting early for senior roles. If Ben wants to triage critical tasks we can loop in Recruiters and Solutions for an interim contractor.
Ben (Manager): IId like a 12 week contractor overlap starting 6/1 to shadow Jordan for 2 weeks before leave. Jordan can own the handoff doc and identify priority projects. Jordan, can you prepare a 1pg handoff and list of oncall/weekly tasks by 5/10?
Jordan K.: Yep will do. Also flagging that Imight want a phased return (80% for first 4 weeks). Do I need to indicate that on LOA now?
Priya (People Ops): You can request a phased return in the LOA comments, but phased return is approved separately by manager + People Ops. Best practice: note intent now and we'll formalize the schedule ~46 weeks before your return so payroll/benefits and manager can plan.
Maya (Payroll): Note on benefits: health premiums continue if LOA is marked paid/topup. If unpaid, you can elect COBRA for the unpaid window but we recommend keeping coverage via company topup. Also, stock vesting schedules are unaffected but RSU payout timing follows plan rules (we dont accelerate because of LOA).
Lena (Hiring Ops): For equipment: if youplan to return to the same role, don't return laptop. If we hire a contractor, we can allocate a spare device. If you leave equipment in office, tag it in the equipment tracker and Ben, please coordinate pickup with IT.
Ben (Manager): Iwill coordinate with IT and the contractor budget. Recruiting: please start a contractor req, title "Sr SW Eng (contract)  shadow Jordan".
Priya (People Ops): A couple extra items: - If you want parental leave pay advanced for the first pay period, submit the "leave_advance" form. - If you plan international travel while on leave it may affect visa/immigration status; reach out to People Ops for casework.
hr-bot: Automated reminder: submit LOA by 2025-05-20 to meet payroll cutoff.
Jordan K.: Great thanks everyone — Iwill submit LOA by 5/15, draft handoff and indicate phased return intent. Ben, Iwill put tasks list in the handoff doc and schedule a 30m walkthrough next week.
